title: Seth Meyers Drags Jensen Huang’s Daily 90-Minute Therapy Sessions
summary: “You’re in therapy for an hour and a half every day? Well, now everything’s falling into place — you’d have to sell secrets to China to afford that much therapy,” Meyers said.
